en.headline: Amber rainstorm and thunderstorm warnings in force this morning
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued an Amber Rainstorm Warning at 6.40am, with the Thunderstorm Warning also remaining in force under a broad trough of low pressure.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the Amber Rainstorm Warning Signal at 6.40 a.m. on Monday. The signal means heavy rain has fallen or is expected to fall generally over Hong Kong, exceeding 30 millimetres in an hour, and is likely to continue.

The Observatory said there will be flooding in some low-lying and poorly drained areas. Heavy rain may also bring flash floods, and people should stay away from watercourses. Those likely to be affected by flooding were advised to take necessary precautions to avoid losses.

A Thunderstorm Warning first issued at 7 p.m. on Sunday remains in force. Under the influence of a broad trough of low pressure, showers are expected to be heavy at times at first today, with the maximum temperature around 28 degrees. Members of the public were urged to complete necessary flood precautions promptly and to follow the latest weather information.

zh.headline: 黃色暴雨及雷暴警告今早生效
zh.dek: 天文台於上午6時40分發出黃色暴雨警告信號，雷暴警告亦繼續生效，受廣闊低壓槽影響本港有大雨。
body: 香港天文台於星期一上午6時40分發出黃色暴雨警告信號。黃色暴雨警告表示香港廣泛地區已有或預期有大雨，降雨量每小時超過30毫米，並可能持續。
天文台表示，部分低窪及排水較差地區可能出現水浸。大雨亦可引發山洪暴發，市民應遠離河道。可能受水浸影響的人士應採取適當措施，避免損失。
周日下午7時發出的雷暴警告繼續生效。受廣闊低壓槽影響，今日初段驟雨間中有大雨，日間最高氣溫約28度。天文台呼籲市民盡快完成防洪措施，並留意最新天氣資訊。
